attack_parameters.description: 2.6.4: Spoofer antenna on a vehicle roof. From 11:44 to 11:54 (UTC), the vehicle is stationary, spoofed position ~true. Simultaneous GLONASS G1 jamming. After 10 minutes, vehicle drives south at 40 km/h along FV7702, while the spoofed position begins moving due south at 40 km/h (a slightly different direction). Scenario ends at 12:04.
